description: This file defines the TaxRate entity class used for representing tax rate data in the application. It includes fields for tax rate details, relationships to other entities like TaxClass, Country, Zone, and supports persistence via JPA annotations.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Represents a tax rate with priority, rate value, applicable country, zone, tax class, and parent tax rates, including audit information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the tax rate.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the tax rate.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves audit information for the entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets audit information for the entity.

methods.name: getTaxPriority
methods.description: Gets the tax priority.

methods.name: setTaxPriority
methods.description: Sets the tax priority.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Returns the tax rate as BigDecimal.

methods.name: setTaxRate
methods.description: Sets the tax rate.

methods.name: isPiggyback
methods.description: Indicates if the tax rate is a piggyback rate.

methods.name: setPiggyback
methods.description: Sets the piggyback status.

methods.name: getTaxClass
methods.description: Returns the associated TaxClass.

methods.name: setTaxClass
methods.description: Sets the associated TaxClass.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets the list of TaxRateDescription objects.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of TaxRateDescription objects.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the MerchantStore associated with this tax rate.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Sets the MerchantStore.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country applicable for this tax rate.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Gets the country for this tax rate.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Sets the applicable zone.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Returns the zone applicable for this tax rate.

methods.name: setTaxRates
methods.description: Sets child tax rates.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Returns list of child tax rates.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent TaxRate.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent TaxRate.

methods.name: setStateProvince
methods.description: Sets the state or province code.

methods.name: getStateProvince
methods.description: Gets the state or province code.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the tax code.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the tax code.
